description.purpose: GH #81: a `remind` tool lane. An agent tool call reaches the timer through the ordinary dispatcher unwrap, the timer answers with a tool_result on the inbound id, and the schedule it created fires into the notify lane.
description.use_when: As the minimal reference for driving a timer as a tool, and as the end-to-end regression for the ack.
description.not_in_scope: No llm cell (the agent turn is posted over HTTP), no collector, no fan-in over several tools.
examples: POST an assistant tool_call {name: remind, arguments: {op: add, ...}} to /dispatch: the ack lands at /ack carrying the inbound call id; a following {op: trigger} fires the schedule into /notify.
